notes.title: First Update Since Launch
notes.content:
This update includes:

-Daily Challenge Mode (Only get one try, no pausing, goes for 24 hours starting at noon Pacific Time)

-Introduction of Meritocracy XP, this will eventually be used to unlock new playable characters.

-Leaderboards are running on a more reliable, sustainable system. Added two additional Leaderboards: Daily Challenge and Merit Champions.

-Title screen now displays the current most qualified to be POTUS (top average score take from Daily Challenge games)

-Optimized for the Steam Deck

-Cloud Saves have been added

-Fixed some minor bugs, removed the "Furry" character that was not intended for the initial release.
